# CloudSync Terms of Service

**1. Definitions**
For the purposes of this agreement, "CloudSync" refers to the software-as-a-service platform provided by CloudSync Inc. that enables users to store, synchronize, and manage digital files across multiple devices. "User" or "Customer" denotes any individual or legal entity that creates an account to access the Services. "Content" includes all data, files, documents, and other materials uploaded, stored, or transmitted by the User through the Services.

The term "Services" encompasses the software application, associated APIs, storage infrastructure, and any related features or tools made available by CloudSync Inc. to the User under this agreement. This definition includes both the core synchronization functionality and any add-on modules or premium features that the User may elect to purchase. "Personal Data" refers to any information that identifies or could reasonably be used to identify a specific individual, which is subject to separate privacy policies.

"Authorized Users" are defined as individuals granted access to a specific CloudSync account by the primary account holder. These individuals must adhere to the same terms and conditions as the primary User. Any breach of these terms by an Authorized User is considered a breach by the primary account holder. "Third-Party Services" refers to any external applications or platforms that integrate with CloudSync but are not owned or operated by CloudSync Inc.

**2. Account Terms**
To access the Services, you must register for an account by providing accurate, current, and complete information. You are solely responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials, including your username and password, and for all activities that occur under your account. You agree to immediately notify CloudSync Inc. of any unauthorized use of your account or any other breach of security.

You represent and warrant that you are of legal age to enter into a binding contract and that your use of the Services complies with all applicable laws and regulations. If you are registering on behalf of an organization, you warrant that you have the authority to bind that organization to these Terms. CloudSync Inc. reserves the right to request additional documentation to verify your identity or the legitimacy of your organization at any time.

You are prohibited from sharing your account credentials with unauthorized third parties, except as permitted under our specific team or enterprise plans. Each account is intended for the exclusive use of the registered User and their designated Authorized Users. Any attempt to share, sell, or transfer account access in violation of these terms will result in immediate suspension or termination of the account without prior notice.

**3. Payment Terms**
For paid subscription plans, fees are billed in advance on a recurring monthly or annual basis, as selected at the time of purchase. Prices are listed in United States Dollars (USD) unless otherwise specified, and all fees are non-refundable except as required by local law. CloudSync Inc. reserves the right to modify pricing at any time, provided that such changes will only apply to future billing cycles and will be communicated to you at least thirty days in advance.

You authorize CloudSync Inc. to charge the payment method on file for the applicable subscription fees. If a payment fails due to insufficient funds or an expired card, we will attempt to re-process the charge. If the charge remains unsuccessful after three attempts, your access to the Services may be suspended until the outstanding balance is settled. You agree to pay any taxes, duties, or fees associated with your use of the Services as required by law.

Customers may cancel their subscription at any time through their account dashboard. Upon cancellation, access to the Services will continue until the end of the current billing period, after which the account will be downgraded to a free tier or terminated, depending on the specific plan. No pro-rated refunds will be issued for partial months of service unless explicitly stated in a separate promotional agreement or required by local consumer protection laws.

**4. Acceptable Use**
You agree not to use the Services for any illegal purpose, including but not limited to the distribution of malware, the facilitation of cyberattacks, or the transmission of content that violates intellectual property rights. You are strictly prohibited from using the Services to store, share, or transmit any content that is defamatory, obscene, pornographic, or promotes hate speech, violence, or discrimination. Any violation of these policies may result in the immediate removal of the offending content and suspension of your account.

You may not attempt to reverse engineer, decompile, or disassemble the Services, nor may you access the underlying infrastructure or data centers without explicit written permission from CloudSync Inc. Automated access methods, such as bots, scrapers, or spiders, are prohibited unless you have obtained a specific API license. Furthermore, you agree not to interfere with the proper working of the Services or the rights of other users, including by overloading the network or server resources.

You are responsible for ensuring that your Content does not infringe upon the rights of any third party. If we receive a valid notice of infringement or become aware of such a violation, we reserve the right to remove the Content and terminate your account. We also reserve the right to monitor usage patterns to detect abuse or security threats, and we may take necessary actions to protect the integrity of the Services and the safety of our community.
